description: releaseCapture path-confinement cases exercised by the Windows (C#) and Android native releaseCapture probes. Deletion is allowed only for a relative leaf inside the capture directory.

cases.reason: a plain relative leaf inside the application capture directory
file URI resolving to a relative leaf inside the capture directory
empty uri must return without deleting anything
the capture directory itself is not a file
relative path escaping the capture directory must not be deleted
a filename containing a path separator must not be deleted
absolute path outside the application folder must not be deleted
a filename containing a NUL byte must not be deleted
